facts.statement: Caenagnathasia is a small theropod dinosaur belonging to the family Caenagnathidae, found in Uzbekistan during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Caenagnathasia ('recent jaw from Asia') is a genus of small caenagnathid oviraptorosaurian theropod from the Late Cretaceous of Uzbekistan.

facts.statement: The species Caenagnathasia martinsoni was named and described in 1994 by Philip J. Currie, Stephen Godfrey, and Lev Nessov.
facts.quote: The type species Caenagnathasia martinsoni was named and described in 1994 by Philip J. Currie, Stephen Godfrey and Lev Nessov.

facts.statement: The genus is based on the holotype specimen N 401/12457, which consists of a pair of fused lower jaw bones.
facts.quote: The genus is based on holotype N 401/12457, a pair of fused dentaries of the lower jaws.

facts.statement: The holotype was found near Dzharakuduk in the Bissekty Formation around 90 million years ago, making Caenagnathasia the oldest known caenagnathoid.
facts.quote: The specimen was found near Dzharakuduk in layers of the Bissekty Formation, dating to the Turonian-Coniacian, around 90 mya, making it the oldest known caenagnathoid.

facts.statement: New material including vertebrae, a dentary, and a femur was described in 2015 from the same site as the original holotype.
facts.quote: In 2015, new material of Caenagnathasia was described. From the same site as the holotype, the material includes various vertebrae, a dentary, and a femur.

facts.statement: The known jaw fragments are only a few centimeters long, with an estimated total skull length of 3 inches.
facts.quote: The jaw fragments are only a few centimetres long and total skull length has been estimated at 3 in.

facts.statement: A 2010 estimate by Gregory S. Paul suggested the animal was 2 feet long and weighed 3 pounds.
facts.quote: A 2010 estimate by Gregory S. Paul gave it a length of 2 ft and a weight of 3 lb.

facts.statement: Caenagnathasia is the smallest known oviraptorosaur and one of the smallest non-avian dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Caenagnathasia es el oviraptorosauriano más pequeño conocido y uno de los dinosaurios no aviares más pequeños.

facts.statement: The jaw fragments are only a few centimeters long, and the total skull length has been estimated at 7.6 cm.
facts.quote: Los fragmentos de mandíbula miden sólo unos pocos centímetros de largo y la longitud total del cráneo se ha estimado en 7,6 cm.

facts.statement: A 2010 estimate by Gregory S. Paul gave it a length of 0.61 meters and a weight of 1.4 kg.
facts.quote: Una estimación de 2010 realizada por Gregory S. Paul dio una longitud de 0,61 metros y un peso de 1,4 kg.

facts.statement: It had three fingers on each hand and the same number on its feet, with bones fused in the same way as birds.
facts.quote: Tenía tres dedos en cada mano e igual número en los pies, con huesos fusionados de igual manera que las aves.

facts.statement: The dentary lacked teeth, making it the oldest known oviraptorosaur with this characteristic.
facts.quote: El dentario no poseía diente y es más antiguo oviraptorosauriano conocido con esa característica.

facts.statement: The type species Caenagnathasia martinsoni was named and described in 1994 by Philip J. Currie, Stephen Godfrey, and Lev Nesov.
facts.quote: La especie tipo Caenagnathasia martinsoni fue nombrada y descrita en 1994 por Philip J. Currie, Stephen Godfrey y Lev Nesov.

facts.statement: The specific name honors Gerbert Genrikhovich Martinson.
facts.quote: El nombre específico honra a Gerbert Genrikhovich Martinson.

facts.statement: Remains were found near Dzharakuduk in Uzbekistan and in the Bostobinskaya Svita Formation in Kazakhstan, dating from the Turonian to Coniacian around 90 million years ago, making it the oldest known caenagnathid.
facts.quote: Los restos del cenagnatasia se encontraron cerca de Dzharakuduk en capas de la Formación Bissekt en Uzbekistán y en la Formación Bostobinskaya Svita en Kazajistán, datando entre el Turoniano y el Coniaciano, alrededor de 90 millones de años atars, haciéndole el cenagnátido más viejo conocido.

facts.statement: A second specimen, N 402/12457, a right dentary of a slightly smaller individual, was referred to the species.
facts.quote: Un segundo espécimen fue referido a la especie, N 402/12457, un dentario derecho de un individuo ligeramente más pequeño.

facts.statement: Specimens consisting mainly of lower jaws were initially assigned to birds by Sternberg in 1940 and Cracraft in 1971.
facts.quote: Los especímenes que consisten sobre todo en quijadas inferiores, fueron asignados inicialmente a aves por Sternberg en 1940 y Cracraft en 1971.

facts.statement: Caenagnathasia is a basal member of the family Caenagnathidae, and it is speculated that it is near the time when this family and Oviraptoridae separated.
facts.quote: Caenagnathasia es un miembro basal de la familia Caenagnathidae y se especula que está cerca del momento de que esta familia y Oviraptoridae se separaron.

facts.statement: However, it has been suggested that it might have a more basal position in Oviraptorosauria, outside of Caenagnathoidea.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, se ha sugerido que podría tener una posición más basal en Oviraptorosauria, fuera de Caenagnathoidea.

facts.statement: In 2015, after the description of new material, it was found that Caenagnathasia could confidently be referred to Caenagnathidae.
facts.quote: En 2015, después de la descripción de nuevos materiales, se encontró que Caenagnathasia podría confiadamente ser referido a Caenagnathidae.

facts.statement: It lived at the end of the Cretaceous period, 92 million years ago in the Turonian, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace 92 millones de años, en el Turoniense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: The time range for the genus is from the Turonian to the Campanian, between 93.9 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Campanian (93.9 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: It is speculated that Caenagnathasia lived near the time when the family Caenagnathidae and Oviraptoridae separated.
facts.quote: se especula que está cerca del momento de que esta familia y Oviraptoridae se separaron.
